Nour El Idrissi
Junior Full-Stack Developer (TypeScript, Python, LLMs)
Fes, Morocco · nour.elidrissi@example.com · https://github.com/example-nour

PROFILE

Portfolio site (Next.js, Tailwind CSS) · 2024

jobText:
Backend Developer (Python)
Sortwise

This is a remote position.

Sortwise helps e-commerce brands sync their product catalog across marketplaces. We are looking for a backend developer to join our platform team.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain REST APIs in Python.
- Design PostgreSQL schemas and background jobs.
- Containerize services and keep our deployments reliable.

Requirements
- 2+ years of backend development experience.
- Strong Python.
- Experience with FastAPI or Django.
- PostgreSQL.
- Docker.
- Good REST API design.

Nice to have
- AWS.
- Redis.
- Celery or other task queues.

We offer a competitive salary, flexible hours and a yearly team retreat.
